notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
In this protracted update, I have redesigned the mechanics of keystrokes. Many players noted that when mistakenly pressed, it is difficult to notice the error and continue to play. Now incorrect presses are marked in different colors and do not interfere with the game process as before. The reason for the delay in update is that I am simultaneously working on a new game mode (which finally makes EasyPianoGame a game) with falling notes.

[h2]What is new:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added protection against erroneous presses (can be disabled in the settings)
[*] Added auto-detection of non-pressed keys (can be disabled in the settings)
[*] When a MIDI device is connected, you can take the volume from the device or from a song
[*] Added the ability to disable auto-sustain pedal
[*] Added welcome window and button for questions
[*] Inappropriate file warnings added
[*] Added Grootian language (just in case ːsteamfacepalmː) 
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The metronome did not stop when it reached the end of the song
[*] Fixed many minor problems in the tutorial mode
[*] Training mode facilitated
[*] Sound delay reduced 
[/list]

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
This is the first update of the game! The main thing I've added is a resolution change feature in the game settings. Many players had problems with an incorrect screen resolution, but there was no way to change the resolution. Therefore, the first thing I did was deal with this very problem. Now you can change the screen resolution, as well as run the game in windowed mode. Adding this feature required big changes in the game code, as a result of which I could not update the game as quickly as I planned.

[h1]What is new:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Resolution change feature
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Incorrect resolution recognition on dual-monitor machines
[*] The game did not see files with the extension .MID
[*] Incorrect count of the number of songs in a folder
[*] 
[/list]
[h1]In the next update:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Сhanging keystroke mechanics
[/list]
